title: 墨衡的家：一間讓 AI 記得自己撞過哪些牆的實驗室
summary: 從 Claire 喜歡的 ASCII 架構圖出發，介紹 AI Playground 作為墨衡研究基地的責任邊界、Repository 目錄、Netlify 研究 Catalog 建置、跨對話記憶恢復，以及 Notion／Work Order 協作分流。
flow: Repository responsibility → research knowledge layers → Catalog build and Netlify publication → Primary bootstrap → delegation and formal implementation boundaries.
